content:
maria_sales: Hey team — Orbit Analytics POC starts EOD tomorrow. Need guidance and someone to provision a hosted API key for them. Requirements:
- short-lived (24h) demo key
- IP allowlist (customer IPs)
- restrict to generation+embeddings models only
- per-key usage cap ~50k tokens/day
- rotation workflow + quick revocation instructions for support
- audit evidence for security questionnaire
Can someone create the initial key and paste the minimal steps we should give the customer?

liam_se: I can do the initial key. For the POC we usually create a scoped key in the Console under the "POC" project, tag it with the account, and set an expiry. Quick checklist: 
1) Console: New Key -> name "orbit-poc-24h" -> expiry = 24h -> allowed models: select only the embeddings/generation family -> add IP allowlist (customer CIDR).
2) Set usage cap: use the per-key quota field (50k tokens/day).
3) Add tags: team:sales, poc:orbit, owner:maria_sales.
4) Share the key securely (1Password or secure upload link).

morgan_se: Addendum — automation and rotation snippets below. We recommend customers rotate keys via our keys API rather than reusing static keys. Example curl to create one with TTL and allowed models:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"orbit-poc-24h","expires_in":86400,"allowed_models":["redwood-embed-v1","redwood-text-v1"],"ip_allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24"],"usage_limit":{"tokens_per_day":50000}}'
```

Response will include the key value. To revoke/delete:

```bash
curl -X DELETE https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/<key_id> \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

morgan_se: For the customer-facing doc snippet we give them: 1) Use the key as Bearer header 2) Rotate daily via a small cron that calls the create endpoint and swaps creds into their secret manager 3) On failure fallback to the demo read-only key (we can provide).

jin_eng: Automation note — if you want zero-trust style, create ephemeral tokens (STS) scoped to a short session token instead of long-lived keys. We support: /v1/keys/issue with parent_key and session_ttl. Example payload: {"parent":"orbit-poc-rotation","session_ttl":3600}. Then customer rotates hourly. More work but better for security.

sec-qa: For the questionnaire we'll need: proof of rotation (audit logs), evidence of IP restriction, evidence of model scoping, and an export of per-key usage for the POC window. Can the audit export run for the key id?

audit-bot: Audit export available — keys.events CSV for key_id orbit-poc-24h between 2026-03-19T00:00:00Z and 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z. Link: https://redwood-internal/audit/exports/exp-8832 (access rights required).

deploy-bot: Key created: id=key_43f6b, name=orbit-poc-24h, created_by=liam_se, created_at=1799990020, expires_at=1799998660

maria_sales: Awesome, thanks. I'll share the key with the customer via 1Password and include the short doc from Morgan. sec-qa — will the audit CSV be sufficient for their infosec contact?

sec-qa: Yes, the CSV includes create/issue/revoke events with actor and timestamps. If they require signed attestations we can provide a signed digest. Also recommend we confirm whether they need HSM-backed keys — that's only for Private deployments.

liam_se: FYI I've set the per-key alert: notify #support if usage > 75% of quota. If they spike we can throttle or rotate.

maria_sales: Perfect. Can someone add a short runbook for support to the POC ticket so on-call knows how to revoke the key quickly?

morgan_se: Will add runbook to ticket POC-3421: steps to revoke (Console -> Keys -> search orbit-poc-24h -> Delete) + API delete snippet, and escalation to eng if audit export requested.

maria_sales: Thanks all — closing loop. :white_check_mark:
